'''Transit Procedures''' was a branch of [[Situational Enforcement/Legends|Situational Enforcement]], part of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. They investigated all issues concerning shipping and commerce between Authority-controlled [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. Transit Procedures had two branches; [[Piracy (Transit Procedures)|Piracy]] and [[Smuggling (Transit Procedures)|Smuggling]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
